figures.caption: FIGURE 4 | (a) First‐cycle charge–discharge voltage profiles at 0.1 C and 25°C of NCM/Li all‐solid‐state half‐cells using SE@CAM and SE–SP@ CAM electrodes. (d) Nyquist plot, (e) rate performance, and (f) corresponding cycling performance of all‐solid‐state half‐cells using SE@CAM and SE–SP@CAM electrodes. Cycling performance was conducted under a 0.1 C charge/0.5 C discharge condition.
